commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
90+6' Yellow card. Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+5' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
90+4' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90+1' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Ben Davies is replaced by Djed Spence (Tottenham).
88' Here's the change. Mathys Tel leaves the pitch and Dane Scarlett (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.
87' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

83' Trai Hume (Sunderland) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Guglielmo Vicario produces an easy save. The ball is out of play. Sunderland will have a chance to score from a corner.
83' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
82' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Eliezer Mayenda and he is replaced by Christopher Rigg (Sunderland).

80' 1 - 1 Goal! Enzo Le Fee displays great vision and sends a pass to Brian Brobbey (Sunderland), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
80' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!

79' Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
78' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
77' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) picks up a long through ball, but Robin Roefs deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
77' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Stuart Attwell signals a foul.
76' The attendance for today's match is 60877.
72' Lucas Bergvall comes onto the pitch after Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
72' It will be a substitution. Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) is ready to enter the pitch as Archie Gray walks off.

70' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Robin Roefs allowed him to make a comfortable save.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sunderland.
70' Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Sunderland have a corner.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) comes onto the pitch for Simon Adingra.
64' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
64' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.
63' Trai Hume (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Sunderland will take a corner.
61' The free kick is taken by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), but ball is cleared.

59' Substitution. Dennis Cirkin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Romaine Mundle (Sunderland).
58' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
58' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Tottenham earn a free kick.
56' Richarlison (Tottenham) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
55' The resulting corner, taken by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland), comes to nothing.
54' What a big chance! Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
52' Ben Davies (Tottenham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
52' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
52' Richarlison (Tottenham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Tottenham earn a corner.
51' Trai Hume (Sunderland) plants a goal-bound header low towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Alderete (Sunderland) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' Dennis Cirkin (Sunderland) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Dennis Cirkin (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well wide of the right post.
40' Wonderful movement by Tottenham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
37' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
34' Stuart Attwell blows the whistle, Simon Adingra (Sunderland) is penalised for a foul.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Micky van de Ven takes aim and his effort deflects off Ben Davies (Tottenham) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:0.
30' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

28' Robin Roefs doesn't have to worry about that one. Ben Davies puts a cross in towards Richarlison (Tottenham), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post.

26' Nice move, nice attempt! Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
25' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
25' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

22' A cross by Pedro Porro (Tottenham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
21' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ben Davies (Tottenham).
20' Trai Hume (Sunderland) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
20' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
19' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) is substituted due to injury. Thomas Frank gives a chance to Randal Kolo Muani.
17' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' The resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared by the defence.
13' A long ball forward to Richarlison (Tottenham) is intercepted. Tottenham win a corner.

11' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Robin Roefs who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
11' Ben Davies (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Roefs intercepts the ball.

9' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
8' Richarlison (Tottenham) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
7' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Archie Gray (Tottenham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

2' Robin Roefs makes a good save! Mathys Tel (Tottenham) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a low shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
